address: Earl of Mar Estate, Mar Hall Avenue, Bishopton,PA7 5NW
bio: Indulge in a decadent Afternoon Tea at the prestigious Mar Hall Golf & Spa Resort in the rolling hills outside of Glasgow, where you can enjoy sweets, savouries and scones.  Set just at the tip of the River Clyde, a stones-throw away from Dumbarton and other lakeside resorts, this stunning locale is perfect for a weekend getaway.  Inside is as opulent and jaw-dropping as interiors go: towering chandeliers, plush carpets and upholstery and a muted colour palette make this an idyllic respite from the hustle and bustle of cities.  Feast on three tiers of quintessentially British finger sandwiches, homemade scones with preserves and a delicious selection of sweet treats.  It's handily located just across the river from Kilpatrick Rail Station, just over Erskine Bridge.
